Requirement: BMS shall monitor individual cell voltages across all series-connected cells.
Fault_Reaction: Flag voltage signal invalid on acquisition fault

Requirement: BMS shall detect cell overvoltage conditions.
Trigger_Condition: Measured cell voltage exceeds upper safety limit
Fault_Reaction: Confirm fault and assert overvoltage status

Requirement: BMS shall inhibit charging when the defined overvoltage reaction condition is reached.
Fault_Reaction: Set maximum charging current limit to zero and request HV isolation if critical

Requirement: BMS shall notify the VCU of detected cell overvoltage conditions.
Fault_Reaction: Transmit critical overvoltage fault flag on vehicle bus

Requirement: BMS shall monitor the validity and plausibility of cell voltage measurements.
Fault_Reaction: Mark measurement invalid and trigger diagnostic fault reaction

Requirement: BMS shall monitor battery temperatures across defined thermal zones.
Fault_Reaction: Flag temperature sensor fault on out-of-range or open/short circuit

Requirement: BMS shall initiate a defined thermal safety reaction when excessive battery temperature is detected.
Trigger_Condition: Measured battery temperature exceeds upper safety limit
Fault_Reaction: Command progressive power derating and open HV contactors at critical threshold

Requirement: BMS shall monitor contactor state feedback and detect unintended contactor opening.
Fault_Reaction: Log contactor fault and notify VCU of HV state change

Requirement: BMS shall prevent spurious contactor opening commands caused by single-point control faults.
Trigger_Condition: Normal operating state without confirmed critical fault
Fault_Reaction: Maintain contactor hold state unless validated safe-state transition is triggered

Requirement: BMS shall validate all HV activation preconditions including HVIL continuity and VCU enable request before closing contactors.
Trigger_Condition: HV activation or pre-charge request received
Fault_Reaction: Inhibit contactor closure and remain in Standby or Fault state

Requirement: BMS shall detect welded or unintended closed contactors and alert the VCU.
Fault_Reaction: Keep remaining pole open and broadcast critical contactor weld fault

Requirement: BMS shall monitor total pack current and verify measurement plausibility.
Fault_Reaction: Flag current sensor fault and apply conservative current limits

Requirement: BMS shall calculate and enforce dynamic charge and discharge current limits within permitted cell operating boundaries.
Fault_Reaction: Clamp maximum allowed charge/discharge current limits and trigger isolation if limits are exceeded
